blind.description: A wooden weapon rack designed to hold crossbows. It features a planked backboard flanked by square support posts with metal corner brackets. Pegs along the upper rail hold four hanging crossbows side by side, while a low shelf at the base holds loose bolts/arrows in a center bin. The back is flat vertical wood planks with metal corner hardware. Materials are stylized warm brown wood and dark grey iron/steel.
blind.from_above: A narrow rectangular profile showing the thickness of the upright wooden panel, with pegs, crossbow components, and the lower shelf protruding forward to one side.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 3.5 to 4 feet tall (roughly waist-to-chest high on the figure) and roughly 4 feet wide.
